documentation.content:
One of the PVACD Cloud Functions (`pvacd-ingest` / `pvacd-to-frost`, which run as Cloud Run services) returned a `5xx` response.

This is the per-function **error** signal, finer-grained than the workflow-level sync-failure alert: a function can 5xx and be retried by the workflow, so this can fire even when the overall run eventually succeeds. Useful for catching upstream flakiness (HydroVu 5xx, FROST/Cloud SQL hiccups) before it turns into a full sync failure.

**Tuning:** the threshold is `> 0` for the POC so any 5xx is visible. Raise the threshold or `duration` if transient upstream 5xx are expected and the workflow retries absorb them.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx" AND resource.labels.service_name = monitoring.regex.full_match("pvacd-.*")
